name: PoliAni ~Polygon Anime Bishoujo~
original_name: ポリアニ～ポリゴンアニメ美少女～
source:
You play as a pervert teacher who puts cameras up around the school. You can decide where you're putting one up for the night and then you choose a girl to try and haress into giving in to you . . while you do that you might spy another girl doing something you can blackmail her with.

[From [url=http://e-shuushuu.net/image/59401/]a post by amfest[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名变态老师，在学校周围安装摄像头。你可以决定在哪里过夜，然后你选择一个女孩来试图骚扰她屈服于你。。当你这样做时，你可能会发现另一个女孩正在做一些你可以勒索她的事情。

[来自[url=http://e-shuushuu.net/image/59401/]amfest的帖子[/url]]
